subject: english
title: 八上英语同步章节卷 · Units 7–8
label: Units 7–8 When Tomorrow Comes · Let's Communicate!
unit: 八上·Units 7–8 When Tomorrow Comes / Let's Communicate!
source: 人教版八年级上册 Unit 7 When Tomorrow Comes、Unit 8 Let's Communicate!：一般将来时 will（预测未来）、more / less / fewer、零条件句和 if 引导的真实条件句（主将从现）、沟通方式与肢体语言。按八年级单元测试题型编写（不含听力），百分制

items.stem: Do you think people ______ live on the moon in 100 years?
items.exp: in 100 years 表将来，用 will＋动词原形。

items.stem: I hope there will be ______ pollution and ______ trees in the future.
items.exp: pollution 不可数，“更少”用 less；trees 可数，“更多”用 more。

items.stem:
—Will people still use paper money in 50 years?
—No, they ______.
items.exp: Will ...? 的否定回答用 won't。

items.stem: If it ______ tomorrow, we will have the sports meeting in the gym.
items.exp: if 引导的条件句“主将从现”：主句用 will，if 从句用一般现在时表将来。

items.stem: If you heat ice, it ______. This is a scientific fact.
items.exp: 表示客观规律的零条件句，主从句都用一般现在时；主语 it 用 melts。

items.stem: I think there will be ______ cars on the road in the future, so the air will be cleaner.
items.exp: 空气更干净，说明车更少；cars 可数，用 fewer。

items.stem: In the future, robots will help people ______ housework.
items.exp: help sb. (to) do sth.，后接动词原形。

items.stem: If you ______ to the party, you'll have a great time.
items.exp: 主将从现：主句 you'll，if 从句用一般现在时 go。

items.stem:
—I'm afraid I can't pass the exam.
—Don't worry. If you work hard, you ______.
items.exp: 主句表将来结果，省略为 you will (pass)。

items.stem:
—Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it ______?
—Sure.
items.exp: 没听清，请对方再说一遍：say it again。

items.stem: Body language is ______ important ______ spoken language.
items.exp: as＋原级＋as，“和……一样重要”。

items.stem: If we ______ talk to each other, we can't solve the problem.
items.exp: if 从句用一般现在时，否定用 don't＋动词原形。

items.stem: Please ______ me a message when you get home.
items.exp: Please＋动词原形，祈使句。

items.stem: In the future, maybe students ______ go to school. They will study at home online.
items.exp: 后一句说在家学习，所以是“不会去学校”：won't＋动词原形。

items.stem:
—I think computers will take the place of teachers one day.
—______ Teachers can do many things that computers can't.
items.exp: 后面给出反对理由，所以表示不同意：I don't think so。

sections.title: Talk It Out
sections.passage:
Last month, my best friend Amy and I had a fight. She didn't come to my birthday party, and she didn't tell me (16). I was very angry. For a week, we didn't (17) to each other.
My mom noticed that I was unhappy. She said, "If you don't talk to Amy, you will (18) know the reason. Why don't you ask her?" I thought about it. Maybe Mom was (19).
The next day, I sent Amy a message: "Can we talk after school?" She agreed. When we (20), she told me what happened. That day, her grandma was ill and she went to the hospital with her parents. Her phone had no (21), so she couldn't call me. She was really (22) about it.
I felt bad. I didn't ask her before I got angry. We (23) each other and laughed. Now we're good friends again.
I learned an important lesson: good communication can (24) many problems. If you have a problem with a friend, talk to him or her (25). Don't just guess!

items.exp: 没来生日会，也没说为什么。下文妈妈说“不谈就永远不知道原因”。
吵架后一周都不说话：speak to each other。
如果不和她谈，就永远不会知道原因。
想了想，也许妈妈是对的，第二天就去约 Amy 谈。
约好放学后谈，见面时她讲了原委。
手机没电了，所以没法打电话：had no power。
错过朋友的生日会，她很抱歉。
误会解开，两人拥抱、笑了起来。
良好的沟通能解决很多问题：solve problems。
有问题要坦诚地谈，不要瞎猜。

groups.label: B
groups.title: Body Language Around the World
groups.passage:
We don't only communicate with words. We also use body language. But be careful — the same body language can mean different things in different countries.
In most countries, nodding your head means "yes". But in Bulgaria, nodding often means "no"!
Making a circle with your thumb and first finger means "OK" in the US. In Japan, it can mean "money". In France, it can mean "zero".
In China, people often give and receive things with both hands. This shows respect, especially to older people.
How close do people stand when they talk? In some countries, people stand very close to each other. In others, people need more space, and they may feel uncomfortable if you stand too close.
So if you travel to another country, learn about its body language first. It will help you communicate better and make friends more easily.

items.stem: What does nodding often mean in Bulgaria?
items.exp: in Bulgaria, nodding often means "no"。

items.stem: What can the "OK" sign mean in Japan?
items.exp: In Japan, it can mean "money"。zero 是在法国的意思。

items.stem: Why do Chinese people often give things with both hands?
items.exp: This shows respect, especially to older people。

items.stem: What does the writer suggest you do before you travel to another country?
items.exp: 最后一段：learn about its body language first。

items.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
options: How to travel around the world.
Body language can mean different things in different countries.
How to make friends in China.
items.exp: 第一段末句点题：the same body language can mean different things in different countries。

sections.title: My Life in 20 Years
sections.passage:
What (36) ______ my life be like in 20 years? I think I (37) (be) a doctor in a big hospital. I (38) (not live) with my parents, but I will visit them every weekend.
There (39) (be) robots in every home. Robots will do most of the (40) (house), so people will have more free time. People will have (41) (few) traffic problems because many cars will fly.
If I (42) (have) a long holiday, I will travel to many (43) (difference) countries. If I study hard now, my dream (44) (come) true. I believe the future will be (45) (good) than today.

items.exp: in 20 years 表将来，What will ... be like? 问将来会是什么样。
预测将来用 will＋动词原形。
将来时否定：won't＋动词原形。
There be 的将来时是 there will be。
do housework 做家务，不可数。
problems 可数，“更少”用 fewer。
主将从现：if 从句用一般现在时，主语 I 用 have。
修饰名词 countries 用形容词 different。
主将从现：主句用 will＋动词原形；come true 实现。
有 than，用比较级 better。

sections.prompt:
学校英语报以“The World in 2050”为题征文。请写一篇短文：1. 从学习、交通、家庭生活中选两个方面，预测 2050 年会是什么样；2. 你认为那时人与人之间怎样沟通（例如还会不会见面聊天）；3. 为了让未来更好，你现在打算做什么（用 if 句子说明）。要求：80 词左右，题目已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
The World in 2050
points: 现在打算做什么（含 if 句）
语言正确（will、more / less / fewer、主将从现），书写规范
sections.sample:
The World in 2050
What will the world be like in 2050? I think it will be very different.
Students won't carry heavy schoolbags. They will study with smart computers, and robots will answer their questions. There will be fewer cars on the roads, and people will take flying buses to work. The air will be cleaner.
People will talk online more often, but I think they will still meet and talk face to face, because nothing is as warm as a real smile.
If everyone saves energy and plants more trees now, the future will be better. So I will start from myself today.
sections.exp: 写完检查：预测将来用 will＋动词原形，否定用 won't；可数名词“更少”用 fewer，不可数用 less；if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will（主将从现）。
